(async()=>{const s=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const m=await import('/src/studio/architect/model.ts');const p=await import('/src/studio/architect/persistence.ts');window.__qaId=s.useStudio.getState().job.id;const model=m.emptyProject(window.__qaId);const wall=m.newWall(model,model.levels[0].id,[0,0],[4000,0],[{id:'qa-solid',name:'QA authored solid',thickness:200,kind:'solid',hatch:'concrete',densityKgM3:null,rateM2:null,supplierReference:'',rateRevision:'',wastePercent:0}]);wall.id='qa-wall';wall.name='QA repaired wall';wall.height=2700;wall.lifecycle={status:'repaired',reference:'QA repair brief'};model.walls.push(wall);model.openings.push({id:'qa-window',revision:1,wallId:wall.id,tag:'QA W01',kind:'window',offset:2000,width:900,height:1200,sill:900,hinge:'left',swing:'in',lifecycle:{status:'demolished',reference:'QA remove window'}});const saved=p.saveArchitect(p.loadArchitect(window.__qaId,localStorage),model,localStorage);if(saved.error||saved.blocked)throw Error('Fixture save failed');return {fixture:'synthetic authored 4m x 2.7m x .2m wall, .9m x 1.2m window at .9m sill',projectId:window.__qaId}})()

(async()=>{const p=window.__saved();const a=await import('/src/studio/architect/alterationStage.ts');const g=await import('/src/studio/architect/geometry.ts');const basis=a.createAlterationBasis(p,'QA current reviewed source');const results=['before','proposed'].map(stage=>{const r=a.resolveAlterationStage(p,basis,stage);if(!r.ready)throw Error(JSON.stringify(r.blockers));return {stage,volume:g.wallSolids(r.model).reduce((v,s)=>v+s.volumeM3,0),openings:r.model.openings.length,height:r.model.walls[0].height}});if(Math.abs(results[0].volume-1.704)>1e-9||Math.abs(results[1].volume-2.16)>1e-9)throw Error('Wrong stage volume');if(p.openings[0].sill!==900)throw Error('Sill changed');window.__final=p;return results})()
